meta_title: NYCU LIFE | Your campus digital companion
meta_description: NYCU LIFE is a campus digital companion that brings campus buses, course discovery, and campus activities into one place, turning the everyday parts of campus life into a single set of tools.
hero_lede: Buses that run late, school information you can't find, course rules that make no sense? NYCU LIFE brings the everyday parts of campus life together into one set of tools.

story_about_body: The NYCU LIFE team brings NYCU's campus information together—course planning, transit, and wayfinding—into an intuitive, real-time digital experience, so you can enjoy campus life on your own terms.

story_faq_body: Everything you want to know about the team, our products, partnerships, and joining us.
story_faq_a1: We are an independent project team initiated and developed by NYCU students. Because we use these tools every day ourselves, we can see things from a student's perspective and quickly build the features students ask for. All tools, including shuttle lookup and course-planning simulations, are free to use.
story_faq_q2: Does it cover every campus shuttle and express?
story_faq_a2: Yes: shuttles for the Guangfu, Boai, Yangming, Liujia, Tainan, and Kaohsiung campuses, plus inter-campus expresses such as Guangfu ↔ Yangming—live positions and timetables included.
story_faq_q3: Can I export my timetable to my calendar?
story_faq_q4: Do room changes and typhoon days update live?
story_faq_a4: Yes. We sync regularly with the course database (more often during add/drop), and bus timetables follow the latest official announcements so you never make a wasted trip.
story_faq_q5: Where do I report a bug or request a feature?
story_faq_a5: We'd love to hear it. Use the Wish Pool on any product page or DM our official Instagram—your feedback shapes what we build next.
story_faq_a5_pre: We'd love to hear it. Use the

story_faq_a3: Yes. Export a .ics file in one tap and sync it to Google or Apple Calendar—no more typing in every class and room.
story_join_body: Whether you write code, design UI/UX, run social media, or manage projects, NYCU LIFE wants to build with you—clear information architecture and intuitive design that cut through campus clutter. If you believe good digital tools make life simpler, come join us.
story_join_tagline: The next solution might start with you.
story_join_role_motion_hook: Give the app its soul and rhythm!
story_join_role_motion_desc: Craft micro-interactions, fluid transitions and brand motion for our app and web surfaces. Work closely with UX and engineering to land motion design in real products — come make them fun with us!
story_join_role_uiux_hook: From user insight to prototype, solving real campus pain points!
story_join_role_uiux_desc: Plan user testing, map needs into flows and build interface prototypes. Polish interaction details with us and drive product iteration toward intuitive campus tools.
story_join_role_pm_hook: The brain that keeps the team on tempo! (J-types loudly welcome)
story_join_role_pm_desc: The key cross-disciplinary coordinator: track product progress with one hand, plan marketing strategy with the other, and make sure great features ship on time and reach every student.
story_join_role_social_hook: Great products deserve great marketing — spark campus buzz with sharp posts!
story_join_role_social_desc: Blend a keen eye for campus topics with visual taste. From ideation and copywriting to social visuals, turn product value into high-resonance content that makes NYCU LIFE part of everyday campus life!
story_join_role_dev_hook: From zero to one, own the full development cycle and ship!
story_join_role_dev_desc: From ideation and architecture to web/app front ends, back-end APIs, database design and cross-system integration; code review and modular design keep our campus services fast and secure.
story_join_role_sre_hook: Keep the systems up — the team's strongest backstop!
story_join_role_sre_desc: Own K8s infrastructure, GitOps/CI/CD automation, SRE observability and security; when course selection or big events spike traffic, keep the experience smooth for the whole campus!

why_lede: We have all lived on this campus and know exactly where things get stuck. NYCU LIFE sets out to untangle those everyday problems, honestly, one at a time.
why_bus_pain: Campus and city buses run late, with routes and schedules that keep changing, so waiting comes down to luck.
why_bus_answer: Campus Bus shows live vehicle positions and arrival ETAs, bringing campus and city buses together so you know when the next one arrives.
why_info_pain: School announcements and key information are scattered everywhere; drop deadlines and how to reach a professor take ages to find.
why_info_answer: We gather the tools and information students use most into one entry point, making it clearer what the next step is.
why_course_pain: Course selection and general-education or credit rules are confusing, and the same class can count for different credits depending on the path.
why_course_answer: NYCozU lays out 3,760+ courses with credits and time slots clearly, with search and filters in one place, so you stop guessing.
why_commute_pain: Commuting between the Yangming and Chiaotung campuses, transfers and timing are always hard to pin down.
why_commute_answer: Campus Bus presents cross-campus shuttles and buses together, so moving between campuses reads like one complete trip.
products_lede: Each product solves one concrete campus task, and they all share the same clear, easy-to-use design language.
product_bus_feature_1: Every route and express in one place—search a destination to plan
product_bus_feature_2: Live vehicle positions and extra/cancelled runs, so you never miss out
product_bus_feature_3: Favourite stops on the home screen—arrival times at a glance
product_coz_summary: Skip the course lottery. Pack the good ones.
product_coz_feature_1: Pick courses by credits, GE category, and taste in one tap
product_coz_feature_2: Plan timetables 10× faster—no more waiting on the frozen official site
product_coz_feature_3: Search by free periods and rooms to dodge 8 a.m. and clashes
product_activity_feature_1: Every office's events in one feed, with pins you choose
product_activity_feature_2: Register in one tap without hopping between sites
product_activity_feature_3: Countdown push reminders after you sign up
product_map_summary: Get lost on campus and you'll end up as a meatball.
product_map_feature_1: Floor-by-floor room navigation and instant building-code lookup
product_map_feature_2: Accessible and well-lit night routes for the dash to class
product_map_feature_3: Find restrooms, ATMs, and water fountains in one tap
course_lede: Course selection is the biggest headache each semester. NYCozU lays out all 3,760+ courses clearly, so search and filters help you find the right classes fast.
course_point_1_body: Search by course name, code, or instructor, then use advanced filters to narrow down to the classes you actually want.
course_point_2_title: Credits and time slots at a glance
course_point_2_body: Every course shows its credits, time slot, and room clearly, so building a schedule no longer feels frantic.
course_point_3_body: Want to know when a room is free? Just look it up and save yourself from asking around.
devlog_lede: NYCU LIFE keeps iterating. Here are some recent milestones, an honest look at where each product stands.
devlog_1_title: Campus Bus · arrival ETAs go live
devlog_1_body: Campus Bus launches live arrival times (ETA), integrating campus and city bus information.
devlog_2_body: The course discovery platform finishes indexing every course, with advanced filters and room lookup.
devlog_3_body: Online registration, QR tickets, and the admin review console for campus activities are in development, launching soon.
devlog_4_body: A digital campus map is being planned, to be linked with course and activity locations.
